account.label: Site ID
account.help: Domain of the site as added to your Plausible account (e.g. example.com).

credentials.name: PLAUSIBLE_API_KEY
credentials.label: Stats API key
credentials.help: Create one under your team's Settings → API Keys, choosing "Stats API".

endpoint.label: Endpoint (self-hosted only)
endpoint.help: Base URL of your self-hosted Plausible Community Edition instance, e.g. https://plausible.example.com. Leave blank for plausible.io.
